instruction.text: Find the phrase that is repeated in the second paragraph.

feedback.end: Repetition can link paragraphs together by making it clear that both paragraphs are about the same thing. In this example, both of the paragraphs are about lions.

atoms.b:
Lions can run up to 50 mph, but they can only maintain this speed for a short amount of time.

((Lions can also)) jump as high as 38 feet. They use this fact to help catch their prey.

instruction.text: Find the phrase that is repeated in the second paragraph.

atoms.b:
Giraffes can grow up to 5.5 metres tall. Taller giraffes have the advantage of having longer necks, which makes them stronger.

((Taller giraffes also have the advantage of)) being able to reach tree leaves that other herbivores cannot.

instruction.text: Find the phrase that is repeated in the second paragraph.

atoms.b:
London is a large city, which is full of amazing sights, museums and restaurants.

((As London is such a large city)), it is important that it is well-connected. The London Underground offers an efficient mode of transports to the citizens and visitors alike.

atoms.a: In Cardiff, there are lots of beautiful parks, such as Bute park and Roath park.
atoms.b: However, there are lots of abandoned buildings in Cardiff that are falling apart.

atoms.a: It is very difficult to bake croissants. The pastry is very delicate and will often crumble and break if not cooked properly.
atoms.b: Even though it is very difficult to bake croissants, my dad and I are going to try to make some next weekend.

atoms.a: At the bakery, we make our brown bread by hand every day with wholewheat flour.
atoms.b: Wholewheat flour has lots of fibre in it, which is good for the digestive system. It is important to eat enough fibre to support a healthy lifestyle.

atoms.a: It is very cold today. Sarah must remember to wear a coat to school to keep warm.
atoms.b: On her way to school, Sarah chooses to take a shortcut through the big housing estate.

instruction.text: Choose the matching sentence to form the most cohesive paragraph using repetition.

atoms.a: Daisy and her family drove from Brighton to Edinburgh. During the car ride, Daisy and her sister played card games and slept a lot too.
atoms.b: While the girls slept, Daisy’s dads talked about the weather. The eight-hour drive flew by!

atoms.a: Tara often goes to the shopping centre with her friends. Tara usually just looks in the shops and doesn’t buy anything.
atoms.b: At the shopping centre, the group of friends often get lunch in the food court. They normally get pizza, but sometimes they get chips.
